preconditions.description: Trading must be enabled via the enableTrading() function.

The BossBaby contract (0xd8dbe5ac60cd1c0b40c9182cb3eb2392d3df371f) must hold a token balance greater than or equal to swapTokensAtAmount (84138000000000000000000 tokens) to trigger the fee-processing function.

exploit_hint: Trigger the swapAndLiquify mechanism by performing a sell when the contract's token balance is above swapTokensAtAmount. Since the liquidity fees are hardcoded to zero, the swapAndLiquify function will never be called. Verify that no LP tokens are sent to the DEAD address, proving the functionality is unreachable.
